description: This file defines internal futex synchronization primitives for the Abseil C++ library, including platform-specific includes, macros, and a Futex class with wait and wake methods.

classes.name: FutexImpl
classes.description: Implements futex wait and wake operations using Linux syscalls.

classes.name: Futex
classes.description: Public interface class inheriting from FutexImpl.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits on a futex until woken or timeout.

methods.name: WaitAbsoluteTimeout
methods.description: Waits on a futex until a specified absolute timeout or woken.

methods.name: WaitRelativeTimeout
methods.description: Waits on a futex until a relative timeout or woken.

methods.name: Wake
methods.description: Wakes up to a specified number of waiters on a futex.
